requirements: Every controlled surface declares its adoption status here.
Browser surfaces consume the shared tokens rather than copying colour values into a new theme.
The OA mark comes from the controlled logo assets.
Local extensions must preserve the semantic roles and record why an extension is needed.
Visual review evidence does not change repository status or create publication approval.
External publication, deployment and migration remain separately governed.
